## Azure IoT Central  
  
<!--ec05ea54-8c5c-49eb-b7d3-292a98c4757d_begin-->

#### Transition to Azure IoT Hub and Device Provisioning Service from IoT Central  
  
Azure IoT Central for managing devices, applications, or workflows is retiring. Transition to Azure IoT Hub and Device Provisioning Service (DPS), with optional services such as Azure Device Registry, Azure Device Update, and Microsoft Fabric.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Migrate from IoT Central to an Azure-native IoT platform services architecture](/azure/iot-central/core/howto-migrate-to-azure-native-iot)  

ResourceType: microsoft.iotcentral/iotapps  
Recommendation ID: ec05ea54-8c5c-49eb-b7d3-292a98c4757d
